name: Ross Law PDX

offices.label: Ross Law PDX
offices.address: 50 SW Pine St 4th Floor, Suite 402, Portland, OR 97204, USA

about: Ross Law works from Southwest Pine Street in Portland, and what it publishes about its practice is unlike anything else in this ranking: crime survivors, systemic failures and patient safety rather than car accidents.

61 reviews at 4.9. It states no fee model and no free consultation in terms we could record, publishes only attorney bios of the trust pages pillar D looks for, and names no attorney on the pages we could reach.

google.source: Google Business Profile via Places API. 1 listing, counts summed and rating weighted by count

completeness.note: Categories, opening hours, photo count and description come from the Places API. The services list, the Q&A and recent posts are owner-side fields the API does not expose at any price, so they are not scored either way.

ahrefs.source: Ahrefs Site Explorer, batch endpoint, subdomains mode, organic figures for the United States

G1.evidence: Oregon does not publish an attorney register we can query, so licensure is not verified here. The state's own attorney search is the place to check it.

G2.evidence: Oregon does not publish a disciplinary register we can query.

G3.evidence: 1 physical location verified on Google Business Profile. We read the Active Businesses register (data.oregon.gov tckn-sxa6), published as open data by the Oregon Secretary of State and could not identify this firm in it: 3 entity name(s) contain the firm's name and none of them agrees on both the name and the city. A miss there is not evidence that the firm is unregistered, so this gate is unresolved rather than failed.

G5.evidence: Site has served over HTTPS, a working phone number published, no attorney is named on the site we could read. The gate also asks for no misleading claims, which is an editorial read we have not recorded.

G6.evidence: 61 public client reviews across 1 Google listing, above the 10 minimum, and the firm's domain has been registered since 2013-01-17, so it has been operating for more than a year
G6.source: Google Places API and the domain's registration date over RDAP

blocking: about[] was assembled from the fields above, not written. Read it before publishing: it should say nothing the record does not carry.
attorneys[] is empty. Names must be read from the bio pages, not guessed

operating.source: Domain registration date over RDAP, which is a lower bound on how long the firm has been operating rather than its founding date

accountability.evidence: no bar or trial lawyers' association named on the pages we read · no professional liability cover disclosed, which is not scored here: plaintiff firms in this market do not publish it, and an absence shared by every firm separates none of them

results_published.why: the site publishes no case-results page

score.verdict: 1 eligibility gate(s) still to be checked. 3 could not be answered from the available records (G1, G2, G3) and do not count against the firm. Certification needs more of the scale measured than we have managed here, pillar A in particular. Strongest pillar: C; most headroom in pillar A (0/25).
